answer_1.quote: We apply our edit operation based model to five NLP tasks: text normalization, sentence fusion, sentence splitting & rephrasing, text simplification, and grammatical error correction (GEC).
answer_1.outputs: Sequence of span-based edit operations (tag, span position, replacement token) that when applied to the source yields the target sentence.

answer_2.quote: We report sentence error rates (SERs↓) for text normalization, SARI↑ scores for sentence fusion, splitting, and simplification, and ERRANT span-based P(recision)↑, R(ecall)↑, and F0.5‑scores on the BEA development set for grammar correction.
